conclusion: The task entity stores a hash; immutable idempotency claim responses retain the original plaintext token. Generic reads and events do not expose either lease token or its hash. Exact actor/request replay can return an expired original response, but expiry and actor checks still reject submissions.
limitations: Local OS or SQLite file access can read the immutable response cache
This proof uses synthetic local test actors and does not attest real human identity
